description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Missouri Meerschaum / Hirschl & Bendheim
Corn Cob Pipe Wood Display Plaque
Hardwood, Brass, Corn Cob, Approximately 7.25 x 5 Inches
Vintage tobacciana display plaque celebrating Washington, Missouri's historic legacy as the corn cob pipe capital of the world. The finished dark wood mount features an engraved brass plaque titled "An American Heritage - the original Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Pipe," paired with an authentic corn cob pipe held securely by a metal spring clip. The pipe's bowl retains its original green Hirschl & Bendheim factory label on the underside, representing one of Missouri Meerschaum's most storied historical contemporaries.
Beveled dark-stained wood display plaque with black metal spring retaining clip
Engraved brass nameplate featuring the official Missouri Meerschaum company seal
Corn cob pipe featuring a textured shank, metal ferrule, and amber-colored bit
Original green paper label on pipe base marked Hirschl & Bendheim, Washington, Missouri
Plaque measures approximately 7.25 inches wide by 5 inches tall
Condition:
Wood plaque is structurally sound with light edge wear and minor finish scuffs. Brass plate is securely attached with light surface patina. Pipe shows bowl interior darkening and charring consistent with prior use. Exterior cob bowl and amber stem show light handling wear. Underside factory sticker is intact and legible.

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

description: This lot includes a variety of collectible gemstones and minerals such as polished and raw amethyst, agate, and quartz. The collection also features a geode, a small piece of white coral, and a ceramic seashell with gold accents. The stones vary in color, shape, and size, ranging from small tumbled gems to larger raw specimens. All items are in good condition with no visible damage. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or decorative display.

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.

shipping.policy:
Shipping Timeframe:
Orders are packed and shipped in the order that payment is received, Monday through Friday. We typically have orders shipped within 7 business days. We are not open on the weekends or during some major holidays.
Shipping & Handling Charges:
All items will ship via FedEx services. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using dimensional weight to and from both parties' zip codes. Handling charges are not only to cover a full-time shipping department but also to cover boxes, bubble wrap, packing paper, high grade tape, printers, authentication charges, etc.
PO Boxes &
APO/FPO/DPO Addresses:
We do not ship to PO Boxes. This includes APO/FPO/DPO addresses as well. Address used at checkout must be a physical street address. No exceptions, we are unfortunately unable to be flexible on this policy.
If you ignore this, we will attempt to reach out to you once, then cancel your order if no response after 48 hours.
Converting local pickup items to shipping:
We list items as local pickup for a reason and will typically refuse requests to convert items to shipping. If you see other locations shipping an item we have set for local pickup, this is irrelevant and does not mean we are required to do so as well, but you are more than welcome to send us a ticket and discuss it with us.
Third Party Shippers:
We do not partner with any companies or parties that will arrange shipping for local pickup items. If you chose to go this route, do so at your own risk. Once your item has been picked up and signed for, we will not be willing to provide a refund or accept a return for shipping issues or damages due to transportation.
We currently only ship domestically.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.

Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. description:
Natural Quartz Geode Specimen Pair
Crystalline Rock Cavity Halves
Raw Mineral Formation, 2 Pieces
This pair of natural geode halves features interior cavities lined with sparkling crystalline quartz and calcite formations resting within a rugged natural rock matrix. Formed millions of years ago in volcanic or sedimentary bubbles, geodes showcase distinctive internal crystal growth patterns, making them enduring favorites among mineral collectors, geology enthusiasts, and natural decor curators.
Includes two matching natural geode halves with exposed crystalline cavities
Densely packed translucent to milky quartz crystal points and druzy clusters
Rough, unaltered exterior host rock with authentic geological texture and coloration
Measures approximately 9 x 5 x 3.5 inches combined and weighs 2.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Crystal formations are intact with crisp termination points and natural surface variations. Exterior host rock displays natural earthy textures, fissures, and authentic mineral matrix characteristics consistent with wild-harvested rock specimens.

This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.

description:
Natural Petrified Wood Specimen
Agatized Fossilized Wood Display
Natural Mineral Fossil, 10.4 Inches, 2.9 lbs
Substantial natural petrified wood specimen exhibiting well-preserved exterior bark texture alongside a richly silicified interior. Petrified wood forms through permineralization, in which organic plant tissue is buried under sediment and gradually replaced by silica minerals such as chalcedony and agate over millions of years. This freestanding piece displays a varied palette of honey amber, cream, earthy brown, and dark charcoal tones, making it an impressive display piece for fossil and mineral collectors.
Silicified fossil wood with distinct exterior bark and longitudinal grain structure
Polished and natural mineralized faces with chalcedony and agate formations
Cut flat base allowing the specimen to sit upright unsupported for tabletop or shelf display
Measures 10.4 inches long by 6.4 inches wide by 3.8 inches high; weighs approximately 2.9 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in very good display condition. Features expected natural fissures, crevices, and conchoidal fractures typical of agatized wood. Flat cut base is level and stable. No synthetic coatings, glue, or modern repairs detected.

This lot features two natural rough quartz geode specimens showcasing distinct crystalline formations. One piece displays radiating crystalline quartz surrounding an inner hollow, while the companion piece features sparkling druzy quartz lining an irregular cavity with a dark mineral inclusion. Natural geodes form over millions of years within sedimentary or volcanic rock cavities, making each specimen a unique geological study piece popular with rockhounds, mineral collectors, and natural decor enthusiasts.
Two-piece natural quartz geode lot featuring raw, unpolished outer matrix rock

Large assorted mineral and rock collection featuring multiple specimen types including smoky quartz, aragonite, peacock ore (bornite), amethyst, pyrite, obsidian, dendritic agate, and various other raw and tumbled stones. When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. description:
Decorative polished agate geode slice mounted on a black metal display stand. The geode features natural banded stone patterns in cream, tan, white, and amber tones surrounding a crystal-lined druzy center cavity.
The exterior retains a rough natural stone texture, while the front face is polished to highlight the layered agate formation and quartz crystal interior. The piece is freestanding on a rectangular black metal base with a vertical support rod.
Condition is good with visible natural inclusions, surface irregularities, and small chips or rough areas consistent with cut stone specimens. The metal base shows visible dust, scuffs, and paint wear. No brand markings were visible. Natural agate geode specimen featuring a polished cross-section with a crystalline druzy center. This decorative stone piece displays layered mineral banding in tan, cream, gray, and translucent tones with a rough natural exterior shell. Suitable for home decor, crystal collections, desk display, or lapidary interest. The geode has an oval cut shape with visible concentric agate layers surrounding a sparkling crystal cavity. The exterior remains rough and textured while the interior face appears polished to highlight the mineral structure and crystal formation. Earth-tone coloration and natural variations make this a distinctive display piece. Condition is good with visible natural imperfections, mineral inclusions, and rough outer surfaces consistent with a genuine stone specimen. No branding or size markings are visible.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
